briefs.text: Cikande factory fire: 3 dead, 36 missing.
Leeds stun Chelsea 4–1, first win since 1999.
Arsenal 2–2 Newcastle.
Liverpool 4–0 Man Utd; Yoro off in 8th minute.
England beat New Zealand 37–12.
France beat Argentina to reach the final.
BepiColombo enters Mercury orbit after 8 years.
Bolsonaro in ICU in Brasília, stable.
Estonia to shut Russia border from 1 Dec.
Denmark expels attaché over rapper plot.
EU–Indonesia sign trade deal after 10 years.
Costa proposes €1.78tn EU budget.
S. Korea education minister resigns.
Pope Leo lunches with 1,300 poor guests.
El-Fasher's displaced face starvation, MSF says.
40 killed in Cantine attack, Sat.
Somalia expels UAE ambassador.
Nepal PM lands in Delhi on first state visit.
Bangladesh: 30 Awami League homes set on fire.
Amazon nears $7.5bn Decart deal.
Trump threatens tax on firms building abroad, Sat.
70.03% turnout in Ladakh local polls.

heroes.deck: Tehran says it downed another MQ-1 east of Hormuz, its fourth in 24 hours. Bahrain seeks UN action.
